acceptance.executed_stages: verifyNative(createDemo()) then the complete Playwright suite using the same owned fixture
native_scenarios: full native pagination, reverse traversal and prefix isolation
copied identities remain inside native index and relation membership
equal timestamps, exact decimals and changed index revisions
schema-driven updates clear optional values and reject stale revisions
rejected writes preserve source identity and roll back effects
invoice, payment and signed correction use current contracts
dated rates revalue a directed transfer
production uses native resources and explicit subsidiary context
another principal cannot read records or tree members outside its access

browser_scenarios.name: all workspace routes load and all published forms are reachable
async pickers support keyboard selection, clear and empty results without losing the form
create a missing conversion and return to the intact transfer draft
invoice payment and a nested adjustment note compose into a correction
production adds a material input through the same schema and picker
optimistic conflict keeps the draft visible with actionable feedback
appearance persists and mobile navigation remains usable by keyboard
a failed picker query can be retried without losing the draft
changing subsidiary resets collections and copied references stay within scope
native pages continue through empty filters and recover from revision changes
touch layout › dialog pickers support touch selection and restore focus
an accepted write with delayed confirmation keeps one identity for inspection and retry
a late read cannot repopulate the interface after sign out

limits: Current public accounting roots have one business key component; composite prefix behavior is verified in the read primitive.
Backlink lookups bound returned rows, not total relationship work.
Paging and hydration are separate reads; cached pages are not live snapshots.
Chromium desktop and touch emulation do not establish all browser or real-device accessibility behavior.
All 48 forms are reachable; not every business-field combination was exercised.
Persistent notifications, offline drafts, bulk import/export, additional authentication flows and deployment remain outside this packet.
